purpose: Set a lesser acceptable outcome below an ideal one.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vない + までも; adjective negative + までも
Even if we cannot win, I want to reach the final.
I am not asking for every day, but contact me at least once a week.
Even if you do not agree, I want you to hear me out.
formation: Vない + までも; adjective negative + までも
restrictions: The second clause states a lower standard or partial outcome.
mistake: The negative belongs to the ideal that may not be reached.
